#National

```{r}

national_summary <- read.csv("~/Documents/es_314/SOE_Report_F2026/Student Coding/Frida/Data/national_daily.csv")

national_summary$Date.Local <- ymd(national_summary$Date.Local)

national_summary <- national_summary %>%
  group_by(Date.Local) %>%
  summarise(
    nat_mean = mean(X1st.Max.Hour, na.rm = TRUE),
    nat_low  = quantile(X1st.Max.Hour, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    nat_high = quantile(X1st.Max.Hour, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups  = "drop"
  )


```

#Norfolk

```{r}
norfolk <- read.csv("~/Documents/es_314/SOE_Report_F2026/Student Coding/Frida/Data/Norfolk_daily.csv")

norfolk$Date <- mdy(norfolk$Date)

```

#Clean Data

```{r}

national_weekly <- national_summary %>%
  mutate(Week = floor_date(Date.Local, unit = "week")) %>%
  group_by(Week) %>%
  summarise(
    nat_low = mean(nat_low, na.rm = TRUE),
    nat_high = mean(nat_high, na.rm = TRUE),
    nat_mean = mean(nat_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Smooth Norfolk data into weekly averages
norfolk_weekly <- norfolk %>%
  mutate(Week = floor_date(Date, unit = "week")) %>%
  group_by(Week) %>%
  summarise(
    no2_mean = mean(Daily.Max.1.hour.NO2.Concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

```

```{r}

ggplot(national_summary, aes(x = Date.Local)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = nat_low, ymax = nat_high, fill = "National Range (10th–90th %ile)"),
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +
geom_line(
    data = norfolk_weekly,aes(x = Week, y = no2_mean,color = "Norfolk County Mean"),
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  # Formatting and Legends
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b") +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = c("National Range (10th–90th %ile)" = "#608ED8")) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "",
    values = c("Norfolk County Mean" = "#DD5A54")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2025 Weekly Air Quality: Norfolk County vs. National",
    subtitle = "Weekly Mean NO2 concentration (µg/m³)",
    x = "Month",
    y = "NO2"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Fraunces", size = 10,))

```
